loginSubtitle: Enter your organization's workspace ID to continue. You'll sign in on your organization's own identity provider. Manar never collects your password.
tenantSlugHint: This is the short ID your Manar administrator gave you. Each organization has its own isolated sign-in realm.

errors.tenantSlugRequired: Enter a workspace ID to continue.

errors.callbackFailed: Sign-in didn't complete. Please try again.
errors.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
